segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר ״קׇרְבָּן״, ״עוֹלָה״, ״מִנְחָה״, ״חַטָּאת״, ״תּוֹדָה״, ״שְׁלָמִים״, ״שֶׁאֲנִי אוֹכֵל לָךְ״ — אָסוּר. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה מַתִּיר. ״הַקׇּרְבָּן״, ״כַּקׇּרְבָּן״, ״קׇרְבָּן שֶׁאוֹכַל לָךְ״ — אָסוּר. ״לַקׇּרְבָּן לֹא אוֹכַל לָךְ״ — רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹסֵר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who says: An offering, a burnt-offering, a meal-offering, a sin-offering, a thanks-offering,» or «a peace-offering,» and adds: «That which I eat of yours,» the vow takes effect and the food «is forbidden. Rabbi Yehuda renders» the food «permitted» in all these cases. If one says: «The offering, like an offering,» or «an offering,» and adds: «That which I will eat of yours,» the food «is forbidden.» If he says: That which «I will not eat of yours» shall be «for an offering, Rabbi Meir renders» the food «forbidden.»
